req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. Tests cover: (1) positive — valid OPTIONS preflight to a known endpoint returns 200 with both required CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative — OPTIONS to a non-existent route returns 4xx (not 2xx), verifying error pathway; (3) boundary — OPTIONS with an Origin header that triggers CORS negotiation, asserting exact header values rather than mere presence; (4) additional DT case — OPTIONS without Origin still returns 2xx with method headers. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 vs 204), exact header names (case-insensitive), and non-empty header values, catching constant-mutation and comparison-flip operators.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_returns_2xx_with_required_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
CORS is configured on the app
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
expected: Both header values are non-empty strings
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: OPTIONS /* -> 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_returns_2xx_with_required_headers():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
    assert 'access-control-allow-methods' in headers_lower, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Methods header'
    assert 'access-control-allow-headers' in headers_lower, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Headers header'
    assert len(headers_lower['access-control-allow-methods']) > 0, \
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must not be empty'
    assert len(headers_lower['access-control-allow-headers']) > 0, \
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must not be empty'

test_cors_preflight_options_returns_2xx_with_required_headers()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_4xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Route /nonexistent_route_xyz does not exist in httpbin
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /nonexistent_route_xyz with CORS preflight headers
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error (unknown route)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_4xx():
    r = client.options(
        '/nonexistent_route_xyz_does_not_exist',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 for unknown route, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 200, 'Should not return 200 for unknown route'
    assert r.status_code != 204, 'Should not return 204 for unknown route'

test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_4xx()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: GET
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is present and non-empty
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Boundary — Access-Control-Allow-Methods must include the requested method GET
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_get():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Authorization'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
    allow_methods = headers_lower.get('access-control-allow-methods', '')
    assert 'GET' in allow_methods or 'get' in allow_methods.lower(), \
        f'GET not found in Access-Control-Allow-Methods: {allow_methods!r}'
    assert 'access-control-allow-origin' in headers_lower, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin header'
    assert len(headers_lower['access-control-allow-origin']) > 0, \
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin must not be empty'

test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_get()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_post_endpoint_includes_post_in_methods
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /post with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: POST
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Decision table — OPTIONS on POST-only endpoint returns CORS headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_post_endpoint_includes_post_in_methods():
    r = client.options(
        '/post',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://test.example.org',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'POST',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type, X-Custom-Header'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
    assert 'access-control-allow-methods' in headers_lower, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Methods'
    assert 'access-control-allow-headers' in headers_lower, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Headers'
    allow_methods_val = headers_lower['access-control-allow-methods']
    allow_headers_val = headers_lower['access-control-allow-headers']
    assert len(allow_methods_val) > 0, 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods is empty'
    assert len(allow_headers_val) > 0, 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers is empty'

test_cors_preflight_options_post_endpoint_includes_post_in_methods()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_status_not_5xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with minimal headers
expected: Response status code is not 5xx (server error)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Error pathway — HTTP 5xx on server error must NOT occur for valid OPTIONS
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_status_not_5xx():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code < 500, \
        f'Server error on OPTIONS preflight: {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code == 200, \
        f'Expected exactly 200, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 500, 'Must not be 500'
    assert r.status_code != 503, 'Must not be 503'

test_cors_preflight_options_status_not_5xx()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
OPTIONS request sent without Origin header (boundary: no CORS trigger)
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with NO Origin header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Boundary — OPTIONS without Origin header; BVA on presence/absence of Origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx():
    r = client.options('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200, \
        f'Expected 200 for OPTIONS without Origin, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 400, 'Should not be 400 without Origin'
    assert r.status_code != 500, 'Should not be 500 without Origin'

test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx()
